name: Slow Glass Electrode Fouling / pH Drift
description: Gradual continuous negative slope on neutralization pH with downstream compensatory hunting in chemical dosing pump rate (FIT_401).
recommendedSopAction: Inspect pH sensor glass bulb for carbonate scaling or biological biofilm. Perform two-point buffer calibration (pH 7.0 & 4.01). Switch to redundant instrument train B.

name: Upstream Hydraulic Shock Load & Clarifier Washout
description: Sudden step increase in raw influent flow (FIT_101) exceeding equalization buffer capacity, driving clarifier level surge (LIT_101) and subsequent discharge turbidity (AIT_103) & TSS breakthrough.
recommendedSopAction: Divert surplus raw whitewater flow to emergency storm equalization basin. Throttle main clarifier influent gate. Increase flocculant polymer dosing rate to accelerate solids settling.

name: Recirculation Pump Impeller Cavitation & Head Loss
description: Elevated erratic motor current variance (IIT_301) paired with unexpected flow drops in recirculation line (FIT_101), indicating air entrainment or suction strainer clogging.
recommendedSopAction: Inspect pump suction suction strainer for fibrous broke accumulation. Check seal flush water pressure and de-aerate pump casing. Start backup recirculation pump P-102B.

name: Coagulant / Acid Dosing Line Vapor Lock Fault
description: Immediate collapse of chemical dosing flow (FIT_401) to near zero despite normal controller output command, causing unbuffered pH shift and organic COD breakthrough.
recommendedSopAction: Prime metering pump head and open manual vapor bleed valve on chemical manifold. Verify dosing line check valves and chemical day-tank level.

name: Aeration Basin Oxygen Transfer Sag / Blower Fault
description: Dissolved oxygen (AIT_202) dropping below minimum biological respiration threshold (< 1.2 mg/L), leading to incomplete biological oxidation and COD elevation in effluent.
recommendedSopAction: Engage secondary aeration blower unit. Inspect membrane diffuser headers for backpressure buildup. Temporarily reduce organic loading rate to biological aeration basins.
